raw_statement: misread functions: CR is OR, R 11 is R T1, H T0 is R T0, H T1 is R T1, H T2 is R T2. A preceding space is not part of the function.
semantic_whitespace_rule: Leading spaces are layout padding, not part of the function value. Retain original diagram cell columns and widths; exclude leading spaces from normalized database function values. Do not shift existing diagram text to perform semantic trimming.
scope: Exact function labels or complete function-label tokens within accepted ALD block function fields. No substitutions in node identifiers, unit codes, pin labels, signal names or ordinary prose.
history_policy: This supplements the separately preserved UR/UH instruction; do not overwrite the original instruction or accepted correction receipts.
